title: Review compatibility claims
summary: Policy defining evidence, 365-day freshness, and validation rules for customer-facing Puppet/OpenVox/Stagehand compatibility records.
notes: Prose policy with no frontmatter and no ADR/PRD markers, but content states enforceable constraints the system must honor (required evidence types, HTTPS primary-source URL policy, unique IDs and claim tuples, ordering, future-date rejection, 365-day staleness boundary enforced by npm run validate:data). Competing DOC (runbook/checklist) signal; resolved to SPEC per ADR > SPEC > PRD > DOC precedence rule. Mentions commands 'npm run validate:data' and 'npm run verify' but no document paths, so cross_refs is empty.
